card.name: Words completing a comparison or dependence
card.fires_on: The word that closes a comparison or a relationship in explanatory science text, such as "away from", "renal impairment" after "severity of", or "than in EM". It fires where the text is about to say what something depends on or is compared with.

modes.label: Direction or relation phrase
modes.description: A preposition or qualifier within a statement about how one thing relates to another.
modes.example: A comet’s tail almost always points away<< from>> the direction of the Sun.

card.writes: It suppresses words like "depending" and "depends", so it seems to steer the model away from continuing with a dependence phrase.
card.plain: It fires on the word that finishes a comparison or a "more of this with more of that" statement in science text.
